class.name: SceneryTrianglesSink
class.brief_description: Where a scenery's [code]triangles[/code] nodes go as they are parsed.
class.description: Cuts the triangles along the 1 km grid and merges them into chunks - a texture, a cell and a visibility range each - as they are added, so the raw triangles of every include are never kept. A sink with a directory keeps at most [constant BUDGET_BYTES] of geometry in memory and writes its largest chunks to the directory past that; [method finish] puts each chunk together in one [MaszynaTrianglesChunkGeometry] file there. A sink without one keeps everything in memory. Thread-safe.

method.name: add_geometry
method.description: Appends a whole chunk's geometry to the chunk of its texture, cell and range.

method.name: add_triangles
method.description: Adds triangles in world space, three vertices each, cut into the cells they cover.

method.name: cell_get_origin
method.description: The centre of a cell of the grid, which a chunk's positions are relative to.

method.name: create
method.description: A sink writing to [param directory], which is emptied first; an empty one keeps everything in memory.

method.name: finish
method.description: Writes every chunk to [code]<directory>/<index>.res[/code] and empties the sink. Returns a [Dictionary] per chunk: [code]path[/code], [code]position[/code], [code]texture[/code], [code]range_min[/code], [code]range_max[/code].

method.name: get_geometries
method.description: The chunks kept in memory, in the order they first appeared.

constants.constant: Geometry kept in memory by a sink with a directory before its largest chunks go to disk.
